rationale: Consolidate the two reciprocal seed-only Pattern identities into the existing production canonical company, adopt the current legal name, and correct the manager ownership facts. Pattern's terms identify Pattern Energy Group LP as the legal operating platform; its current materials establish a San Francisco headquarters and North American operating footprint. CPP Investments has remained an owner since the 2020 take-private and holds 69.1% following the completed 2026 Cordelio share-based transaction. APG closed its investment on June 9, 2025 through Windmolens, LLC as part of the consortium that acquired Riverstone's entire stake; APG's individual stake was not disclosed. Current acquisition-and-exit searches found no later Pattern-level sale or pending ownership change through the as-of date. Project companies and the now-integrated Cordelio platform are not counted as separate current holdings beneath Pattern.

beforeImage.name: Pattern Energy Group LP (Pattern Energy)
beforeImage.subsector: Wind, solar, storage, and transmission development
beforeImage.description: Pattern develops, owns, and operates wind, solar, storage, and transmission infrastructure across North America and selected international markets. Its customers are utilities, corporate offtakers, and power markets that contract for renewable energy, capacity, and transmission services under long-duration arrangements. The company follows an asset-heavy independent power producer and developer model with a mix of operating projects and a large development pipeline. Public disclosures describe more than 6 gigawatts of operating capacity and a development portfolio that includes major transmission-led growth projects such as SunZia. Pattern was taken private in 2020 and has continued to add long-duration institutional capital to support development and operating growth. A consortium led by APG and Australian Retirement Trust acquired Riverstone's equity stake in 2025 and joined CPP Investments and management as owners, while exact ownership percentages were not publicly disclosed.
beforeImage.headquarters: Texas; New Mexico; California; Canada; Japan

afterImage.name: Pattern Energy Group LP
afterImage.subsector: Wind, solar, storage, and transmission development
afterImage.description: Pattern Energy Group LP is a San Francisco-headquartered developer, owner, and operator of utility-scale wind, solar, energy storage, and transmission infrastructure across North America. The company reports 46 operating facilities totaling approximately 12 GW and a 40 GW development and active-construction portfolio. CPP Investments has owned the platform since the March 2020 take-private and holds 69.1% after Pattern completed its share-based acquisition of CPP-owned Cordelio Power on April 2, 2026. On June 9, 2025, an APG- and ART-headed consortium that also included a CalSTRS buyer vehicle acquired Riverstone's entire stake alongside Pattern management; the individual consortium and management stakes were not disclosed. Riverstone had backed Pattern since its 2009 formation and rolled its interest through the 2020 combination before exiting in 2025.
